scientific_integrity: Exact finite Littlestone ranks follow the complete version-space recursion, with a separate depth-feasibility implementation and graph-distance checks. The all-order logarithmic growth has a direct proof. These are self-review, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The online rank table ends at twenty vertices; no all-order exact dimension formula is claimed. The alternating-parity triple classification was already established by Tian and Xu; priority for online cutoff remains incompletely checked against a relevant inaccessible full paper.
title: The first online entropy deficit for geodesic convexity on squared paths
